verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's API reference documents Persons (contacts) and Organizations (companies) as first-class record types, with endpoints such as merging two persons and adding followers to an organization. That shows contacts and companies can be managed. Nothing in the evidence shows persons linked to organizations or an activity timeline on either record. Missing for 10: documented person-to-organization linking, a per-record activity timeline or history view, first-party UI docs for contact/company management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
